docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,299.00 FILED BY CITY CHIROPRACTIC CENTER AS TO DEFENDANT CLAUSEN CARL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-26-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03
